Rule.title: Zzstorage Fabric must zone its initiators.
Zzstorage Fabric must be supported by the vendor.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>A DIFFERENT requirement carrying the same Rule id, which is what DISA actually ships. Measured 2026-09-02: SV-6802r1_rule in SAN covers V-6656 SNMP access and V-6662 vendor support, and SV-7031r1_rule in MULTI-FUNCTION_DEVICE covers V-6806 administrator restriction and V-6807 vendor support. In both, title, fix text and check text all differ, so the dropped occurrence is a requirement no benchmark ends up holding. A fixture whose two occurrences matched would make the message's claim look true. </VulnDiscussion>

check.check-content: Verify the release is vendor supported.
